description: Connect two existing Views on a diagram with a typed relationship edge. Edge types: 'UMLAssociation' (use case), 'UMLControlFlow' (activity), 'UMLMessage' (sequence), 'UMLGeneralization', 'UMLDependency'. tailViewId is the source, headViewId is the target. Use view IDs from create_element_with_view results. Requires staruml-mcp-extension to be installed in StarUML. Install from https://github.com/ezrabrilliant/staruml-mcp-extension

x.description: Edge tail X coordinate (required for SeqMessage vertical positioning)

y.description: Edge tail Y coordinate (REQUIRED for UMLMessage in sequence diagrams — determines vertical position of the message; without this, all messages stack at same y)

y2.description: Edge head Y coordinate (defaults to y if omitted)

name: create_edge_with_view
